subject: german

moments.title: Die Dreigroschenoper
moments.body: The Threepenny Opera premieres in Berlin; 'Mack the Knife' becomes a standard.
moments.takeaway: Popular theatre could be theoretically ambitious.

moments.title: Brecht exiled
moments.body: Brecht flees Germany, eventually reaching the US. He is later called before the House Un-American Activities Committee.

moments.title: Berliner Ensemble founded
moments.who: Brecht and Helene Weigel, East Berlin
moments.body: Brecht returns to East Germany to direct the Berliner Ensemble.
moments.takeaway: Exiled artists made hard choices about return.

now.title: Brecht's theatre today
now.body: Verfremdung techniques shape contemporary political theatre, from Hamilton to TikTok performance.
now.open_questions: What is the digital equivalent of Brecht's alienation effect?

reflection: Brecht wanted theatre that didn't let you forget you were watching it.
